purpose: Curated primary-study cases for the Article 55 causal-evidence reading framework
selection_rule: One representative microbiome study for each evidence tier; cases illustrate design capacity and do not rank journal prestige or claim that every listed study satisfies all lower tiers
framework_reference: Hill AB. The environment and disease: association or causation? Proc R Soc Med. 1965; doi:10.1177/003591576505800503
note: The chapter is a critical-reading guide. It does not perform statistical analysis and does not treat the ladder as an automatic score.
